thm r99_common_divisor_divides_linear_combination:
    ? forall d,a,b,x,y Z:
        $divides_by(d,a)
        $divides_by(d,b)
        =>:
            $divides_by(d,a*x+b*y)
    obtain p from $divides_by(d,a)
    obtain q from $divides_by(d,b)
    a*x+b*y=(d*p)*x+(d*q)*y=d*(p*x+q*y)
    witness $divides_by(d,a*x+b*y) from p*x+q*y
